log_health.last_line: 2026-09-29 13:28:42,214 | INFO | feed updated | new=3 active=278 signal=-0.076 adjustment=-0.76

review.summary: The paper system operated within all stated risk limits, but same-day evidence is insufficient for model calibration. It generated 3,333 decisions but only two paper orders and one realized exit, so the -$54.95 realized result cannot support threshold, confirmation, exit, symbol, VIX, geo, or regime changes. The clearest opportunities are SHADOW instrumentation and data-pipeline repairs: reconcile threshold-funnel accounting, capture counterfactual forward outcomes, restore the financial-leverage feed, audit geo attribution/deduplication, and improve premarket/ZPTA observability. Keep paper=True and leave all trading thresholds, portfolio caps, loss controls, and dashboard permissions unchanged.
findings: Observed: PAPER-only status is confirmed. Three open positions and approximately $7,475.30 exposure remained below the caps of four positions and $10,000. Two trades remained below the 12-trade limit, and realized P/L of -$54.95 remained above the -$300 daily-loss stop. The $2,500 XOM order was at, not above, the per-trade cap.
Observed: Decision activity was extremely sparse: 3,331 HOLD, one BUY, and one SELL across 3,333 rows. The two accepted paper orders were balanced by side: one XOM buy and one NVDA sell.
Observed: Only one realized trade is available. NVDA realized -$54.95; this sample is too small to estimate win rate, symbol quality, exit quality, or expected P/L.

Observed: AMZN reached 70.499 and XOM reached 71.963, while WMT reached 26.528 and XOM reached 29.492. However, only XOM produced a buy and only NVDA produced a sell. Confirmation state, position eligibility, and exact crossing disposition are not fully represented in the aggregate symbol table.

Observed: Funnel telemetry reports three raw threshold crossings, but four funnel rows split into two BUY and two SELL records. Two awaited confirmation and two were submitted. This may reflect different counting definitions, but the supplied evidence does not permit reconciliation.
Observed: All two order attempts were accepted, with no pre-submit blocks or submission failures. There is no same-day evidence of an execution reliability problem.

Observed: Average VIX adjustments were small by symbol, ranging from -0.018 to +0.006, while individual dashboard adjustments ranged from approximately -0.587 to +0.205. With one realized trade, no causal conclusion about VIX adjustment quality is supported.

Observed: Geo data was live and contributed mainly to XOM and GLD. XOM's average geo adjustment was -0.372 and its displayed adjustment was -0.51, although several highest-materiality headlines were classified as bullish for crude and often bullish for XOM. The overall feed signal was negative, so this is an attribution question rather than proof of a sign error.

Observed: The geo top-event list contains apparent duplicates differing primarily by source capitalization. Duplicate amplification could affect the aggregate signal, but its actual score impact is not provided.

Observed: Regime SHADOW produced 75 RISK_ON observations at score 85, with no state variation. Only two regime-decision records were present, both ALLOW_EQUITY for XOM. This supports pipeline availability but not regime effectiveness.

Observed: Financial-leverage SHADOW produced zero snapshots, signals, or outcomes, and the dashboard reported FINANCIAL_SNAPSHOT_UNAVAILABLE. XLF, FAS, and FAZ premarket gaps were also null. No financial-leverage conclusion is possible.

Observed: Premarket intelligence produced five NEUTRAL snapshots. SPY and QQQ gaps were small and positive, social sentiment was explicitly unavailable, and no evidence links the premarket bias to later outcomes. Social sentiment must therefore remain excluded.

Observed: ZPTA has 56 resolved predictions overall, but every reported model/horizon cell has only four or five samples, below the minimum calibration target of 12. It generated no shadow trades, used yahoo_delayed, and ended with NO_NEW_BAR. No ZPTA threshold or model ranking change is supported.

Hypothesis: Sparse actions may be an intended consequence of 70/30 thresholds plus two confirmations, but the present telemetry cannot distinguish desirable selectivity from missed or inconsistently counted opportunities.

Hypothesis: Geo duplicate handling or aggregation across market-risk and XOM-specific effects may explain the negative XOM adjustment despite bullish oil headlines. A sign defect is possible but not established.
Hypothesis: Missing financial snapshots and stale delayed ZPTA bars are instrumentation/data-availability issues rather than evidence that the underlying shadow strategies lack signal.

proposals.title: Add crossing-level IDs and counterfactual outcome labels
proposals.current: The report contains three raw threshold crossings, four funnel rows, and only aggregate gate reasons. Non-executed crossings lack clearly linked forward outcomes and unique lifecycle identifiers.
proposals.proposed: In SHADOW, assign a stable event ID to every first threshold crossing and link its symbol, side, score, prior score, confirmation count, position eligibility, gate reason, order-attempt ID, and final disposition. Record 5-, 15-, 30-, and 60-minute forward returns for both submitted and non-submitted crossings. Report raw events separately from repeated confirmation observations. Do not alter the 70/30 thresholds or two-confirmation requirements until at least 12 eligible outcomes exist for the evaluated bucket.
evidence: Three raw threshold crossings were reported, while the funnel contained four rows split across two BUY and two SELL records.
Two funnel records awaited confirmation and two produced submitted orders.
AMZN exceeded 70 and WMT fell below 30 without corresponding decision actions in the aggregate table; supplied data does not show the complete eligibility lifecycle.
proposals.risk: Low operational risk because this is append-only SHADOW telemetry. Main risks are excess logging volume and incorrect forward-return timestamp alignment.

proposals.title: Restore financial-leverage SHADOW snapshots with explicit feed-health fields
proposals.current: The feature is enabled with a minimum score of 70 and outcome horizons of 5,15,30,60, but it produced zero snapshots, signals, and outcomes. XLF/FAS/FAZ premarket gaps were null, and the only reason was FINANCIAL_SNAPSHOT_UNAVAILABLE.
proposals.proposed: Repair read-only quote/bar acquisition for XLF, FAS, and FAZ and log per-symbol provider, timestamp, freshness, missing-field reason, and session status on every scheduled snapshot. Keep the feature SHADOW-only, retain the score threshold of 70, and suppress candidate scoring whenever any required input is stale or absent. Begin outcome collection only after valid snapshots are present; do not calibrate until at least 12 eligible signals are available.
evidence: Financial-leverage snapshot_rows, signal_rows, and outcome_rows were all zero.
The latest candidate was null and the dashboard reported FINANCIAL_SNAPSHOT_UNAVAILABLE.
Premarket gaps for XLF, FAS, and FAZ were null while SPY and QQQ gaps were populated.
proposals.risk: A provider repair could introduce inconsistent timestamps or delayed ETF data. Freshness validation and SHADOW-only operation limit model risk.

proposals.title: Audit geo deduplication and expose XOM score attribution
proposals.target: Geo-feed canonicalization and geo score decomposition
proposals.current: The feed reports 278 active events and a negative aggregate signal. Apparent duplicate headlines occur in the top-event list, and XOM received negative geo adjustments despite multiple high-materiality events labeled bullish for crude and often bullish for XOM.
proposals.proposed: Run a parallel SHADOW geo calculation that canonicalizes source domains and normalizes title text, clusters likely duplicate stories, and logs each cluster's contribution separately for crude direction, XOM-specific direction, broader risk effect, confidence, recency, and final signed adjustment. Compare existing versus deduplicated adjustments without changing production paper decisions.
evidence: Two Hormuz headlines appear under energynow.com and EnergyNow.com with the same publication timestamp and substantially identical content.
Two Kharg Island headlines similarly appear twice with capitalization differences.
XOM average geo adjustment was -0.372 and the dashboard value was -0.51, while several top events were classified bullish for XOM.
The aggregate geo signal was -0.0762 with a -0.76 score adjustment, so broader negative aggregation could legitimately differ from individual headline direction.
proposals.risk: Over-aggressive clustering could merge genuinely distinct reports. The parallel calculation must not replace the current adjustment until enough comparisons and forward outcomes are available.

proposals.title: Label premarket gap/bias outcomes and missing-symbol coverage
proposals.current: Five snapshots were all NEUTRAL; SPY and QQQ gaps were available, XLF/FAS/FAZ gaps were null, and no forward outcomes or per-refresh contribution records are supplied. Social sentiment is unavailable.
proposals.proposed: For each scheduled refresh, persist gap values, data freshness, bias inputs excluding social sentiment, resulting adjustment, and 5-, 15-, 30-, and 60-minute post-open returns for SPY and QQQ. Record explicit missing reasons for XLF/FAS/FAZ. Keep the current maximum adjustment, active window, and warmup unchanged, and prohibit calibration until at least 12 eligible premarket sessions or events are collected for the evaluated bucket.
evidence: Premarket intelligence had only five rows and all were NEUTRAL.
Latest SPY and QQQ gaps were +0.163% and +0.323%; XLF, FAS, and FAZ were null.
Premarket adjustments displayed in the dashboard were 0.0.
The social source and status were explicitly UNAVAILABLE.
proposals.risk: Forward labels can be misleading if session boundaries or delayed quotes are misaligned. This proposal does not activate missing social data or alter paper decisions.

proposals.title: Add regime counterfactual outcomes before considering active gating
proposals.current: There were 75 RISK_ON observations with the same score of 85 and only two decision-shadow rows, both ALLOW_EQUITY for XOM. No state diversity or forward-outcome comparison is available.
proposals.proposed: Log regime state transitions rather than only repeated identical snapshots, and attach state, score components, hypothetical allow/block disposition, and forward returns to each eligible threshold event. Produce per-state counts and outcomes while leaving regime logic non-binding. Require at least 12 eligible events per evaluated state before any calibration proposal.
evidence: All 75 regime observations were RISK_ON with average and latest score 85.
Only two regime-decision records existed, both for XOM and both ALLOW_EQUITY.
The latest regime inputs included positive long-term trend evidence but nonpositive SPY 20-day momentum, illustrating why component-level outcome attribution is useful.
proposals.risk: Regime states may remain highly imbalanced, delaying evaluation. No trading behavior changes because the evaluator remains SHADOW-only.

Continue reporting outcomes by model and horizon, with calibration disabled until each evaluated cell reaches at least 12 samples.
